result.title: ExMR: Extremity Motion Refinement for Monocular Human Motion Capture
result.comment: Extended version of the 3DV 2026 paper "Improving 3D Foot Motion Reconstruction in Markerless Monocular Human Motion Capture". 17 pages main paper + 4 pages supplementary material. Project page and video: https://twehrbein.github.io/exmr-website/
result.summary: Detailed hand and foot articulation is important for animation and motion analysis, yet remains challenging to recover from monocular video. Recent expressive video methods infer hand articulation from shared whole-body representations. Our conference work suggests that this underexploits local evidence: the Foot Motion Refinement (FootMR) module refines ankle rotations from foot keypoints, improving reconstruction even when the initial estimator receives the same keypoints. We extend this principle to hands with the Hand Motion Refinement (HandMR) module. Because 2D finger keypoints are often missing or unreliable, HandMR combines image features of a pretrained hand reconstruction model with initial arm and hand rotations to refine elbows, wrists, and fingers. We integrate FootMR and HandMR into ExMR (Extremity Motion Refinement), a system for reconstructing 3D body, hand, and foot motion from monocular video. An initial temporal estimator predicts whole-body motion, after which both refiners revisit local evidence to predict residual joint rotations. Experiments on ARCTIC, MOYO, RICH, and MOOF show that ExMR outperforms state-of-the-art methods in hand and foot reconstruction, reducing hand per-vertex error and ankle joint angle error on MOYO by 19% and 18%, respectively, relative to the strongest competitor. Code will be made available for research purposes. Project page: https://twehrbein.github.io/exmr-website/

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 ExMR 系统，用初始时序估计器预测全身运动，再由 FootMR 与 HandMR 两个精化模块回到脚部与手部的局部证据（关键点、预训练手部模型图像特征）预测残差关节旋转，在多个基准上改善手、脚重建精度。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「共享全身表示会低估局部证据、需在初步估计后重回局部证据预测残差」的两阶段精化思路，可能为 LVR 中潜状态迭代更新、视觉细节保留与信息坍缩问题提供可核查的线索，但属跨任务推测。
